	gs.info('Impact: ' + myImpact + ' AssetType: ' + myAssetType);
	if (!myImpact || !myAssetType) {
        current.suggested_soci_classification = '';
        return;
    }
    //Matrix lookup → result = matrix[impact][assetType]
    var matrixAsset = myAssetType.indexOf('regulated') !== -1 ? 'regulated' : 'corporate';
    var reportMatrix = {
        '1': {
            'regulated': 'significant',
            'corporate': 'relevant'
        },
        '2': {
            'regulated': 'significant',
            'corporate': 'relevant'
        },
        '3': {
            'regulated': 'relevant',
            'corporate': 'no_report'
        },
        '4': {
            'regulated': 'no_report',
            'corporate': 'no_report'
        }
    };
    var myResult = reportMatrix[myImpact][matrixAsset];

    //Floor check → if Data Classification contains PI/SOI/CII AND result === 'no_report' → result = 'relevant'
    var myDataClass = current.getValue('data_classification_of_affected_assets');
    if ((myDataClass.indexOf('sensitive_operational') !== -1 ||
            myDataClass.indexOf('private_information') !== -1 ||
            myDataClass.indexOf('critical_infrastructure') !== -1) &&
        myResult === 'no_report') {
        myResult = 'relevant';
    }

    //Set current.suggested_soci_classification = result
    current.suggested_soci_classification = myResult;

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-02 11:46:52</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>05fa974883e2cb1044779cb6feaad36a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set suggested SOCI classification</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_05fa974883e2cb1044779cb6feaad36a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-02 12:59:23</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=05fa974883e2cb1044779cb6feaad36a"/></record_update>
